47e4bf81.text:
You already felt the call of something greater than yourself, and that's the call of the elements. We dwarves have a strong connection to earth, but with the right training, you can learn to speak to all of the elements. The elementals can be demanding and challenging, but I'm here to guide you in learning how to communicate with them. Come find me in Anvilmar and I'll teach you how to listen to the elements, and how to get them to listen to you.

- Teo Hammerstorm, $C Trainer
47e4bf81.title: Archaic Rune

5e49ba75.text:
ATTENTION:
You must report to Thran Khorman immediately. He is located within building A3; also known as Anvilmar to local inhabitants. After successfully making contact with Khorman, you will proceed to prepare yourself for the coming war--the war to take back our home of Gnomeregan!

All efforts and essential tasks should be focused on achieving this directive. Once accomplished, a new task will be given to you.
5e49ba75.title: Simple Memorandum

7fb899f4.text:
Grelin,

My time is short and many matters press on my time, and I hope that your investigation of the trolls will not be one of them. Therefore I will allow you to use my authority in dealing with the trolls in whatever fashion you deem necessary, more so if you are able to find an expedient solution.


Magni Bronzebeard
7fb899f4.title: A Letter to Grelin Whitebeard

cbd9cbad.text:
Many of our kind resort to the arcane and divine as a means to give themselves strength, but we know better, don't we, $c? We know that our weapons are our holy symbols, our shield is our spell book, and our mail is our wisdom.

Even in undeath we are strong, and we will only become stronger.

Find me in the inn in Deathknell. I will speak to you more of these matters and other things.

-Dannal Stern, $C Trainer
cbd9cbad.title: Simple Scroll

cdac24ff.text:
A Report on the State of the Frostmane Trolls in the General Area of Coldridge Valley

Prepared by Grelin Whitebeard, Senate Special Envoy

From the time that I have spent observing the movement of the Frostmane trolls in the Coldridge Valley area, I have determined that they pose no large threat to dwarven settlements in the area. Moreover, they are a threat that can be eliminated with little additional support from the army. Through the assistance of Mountaineers already stationed in
cdac24ff.title: Grelin's Report

cfb4dfed.text:
DAY ONE

The apprentice and I have arrived in Coldridge Valley today. The trip through the cave was mostly uneventful. We made camp a good distance away from the cave we're told the trolls have gathered in.

DAY TWO

Bloody wolf howling almost kept me up all night.

I will have new wolfhide clothing in a few days.

The lad got tangled up with a trogg today, put up a fight, and
cfb4dfed.title: Grelin Whitebeard's Journal

1569|e2fc85be.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
1569|e2fc85be.text: No other race on Azeroth has suffered as much as our people, $c. To laugh in the face of death has become second nature for all of us.

2119|ed01dd60.name: Dannal Stern
2119|ed01dd60.text: The $c's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.

244808|942bf955.name: Aramis Hammerhand
244808|942bf955.text: You may not be a paladin, but you may yet find solace in the light should you seek it.

257446|1e35c538.name: Teo Hammerstorm
257446|1e35c538.text:
The stone an' soil speak truer than any tongue, if ye quiet the clatter in yer heart long enough to hear 'em. 

If ye've the makings of a $c, I'll teach ye.

267336|0371bf6f.name: Brighid Stormflayer
267336|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

714|7dd450ba.name: Talin Keeneye
714|7dd450ba.text: Greetings, $c! Fine day for hunting, wouldn't you say? I've been having more than a little luck with boars, myself. Perhaps you'd like a shot?

786|b76e4f1a.name: Grelin Whitebeard
786|b76e4f1a.text: Greetings, lad. I'm Grelin Whitebeard. I'm here to examine the threat posed by the growing numbers of trolls in Coldridge Valley. What have I found? It's a bit troubling...

836|b62f5856.name: Durnan Furcutter
836|b62f5856.text: I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!

912|b02b9fad.name: Thran Khorman
912|b02b9fad.text: The big wars might be over, for now, but we still have to keep our skills sharp!

170-accept.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-accept.text:
I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.

I hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.

And that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! 

We're a bit shorthanded here, lad, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
170-accept.title: A New Threat

170-complete.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-complete.text: If the problems we've had here are indicative of what is happening elsewhere in our lands, by Magni's beard, we have some troubles ahead of us! I can only hope that the king and Senate are taking steps to deal with the threat the troggs pose.
170-complete.title: A New Threat

179-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-accept.text:
What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?

I'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.

I need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?
179-accept.title: Dwarven Outfitters

179-complete.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-complete.text: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, $N, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
179-complete.title: Dwarven Outfitters

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

182-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
182-accept.text:
My brother Senir and I were sent to different parts of Dun Morogh to investigate the threat posed by the trolls. The Senate has its hands full with the troggs, so they've no need for further annoyances.

From what I've seen, the trolls aren't well situated here in Coldridge Valley--mostly the southern cave. I'd say that the army will not be necessary. A few strong arms should be more than enough.

Perhaps you'd like to assist in this endeavor? I have the authority to offer compensation for your help.
182-accept.title: The Troll Cave

182-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
182-complete.text:
Argh! Those Light-blasted trolls!

<He takes a few breaths and seems to settle down... a bit.>

A group of them came in the night and stole my journal! I knew better than to trust that good-for-nothing appr...
182-complete.title: The Troll Cave

183-accept.name: Talin Keeneye
183-accept.text:
Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?

Though, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.

Long story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.
183-accept.title: The Boar Hunter

183-complete.name: Talin Keeneye
183-complete.text: Excellent! I can go back to my... leisurely... hunting now. Thank you, $N.
183-complete.title: The Boar Hunter

2160-accept.name: Hands Springsprocket
2160-accept.text:
Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?

You were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.

Anyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!
2160-accept.title: Supplies to Tannok

218-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
218-accept.text:
My journal! They took it away to the cave. The one that had it... It was a big brute with some odd markings on his skin and face. I didn't get a much better look than that.

You've had some luck with the trolls, maybe you could go get it back for me?
218-accept.title: The Stolen Journal

218-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
218-complete.text:
Wonderful, $N! Many thanks for retrieving my notebook. Well, it would seem that the troll situation here in Coldridge Valley is under control and not much cause for worry.

After I put the finishing touches on my report, I'll need someone to courier it to my brother Senir.
218-complete.title: The Stolen Journal

233-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
233-accept.text:
Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, lad? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.

They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

What do you say?
233-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

233-complete.name: Talin Keeneye
233-complete.text:
Thank you, I've been waiting for these letters for quite some time...

Unfortunately, these letters aren't all for me. This one is addressed to Grelin Whitebeard. He's not too far away if you'd like to deliver it to him.
233-complete.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

233-progress.name: Talin Keeneye
233-progress.text: Yes? Do you have something for me?
233-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-accept.name: Talin Keeneye
234-accept.text: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.
234-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-complete.text: Ahh, excellent. It's been a while since I received word from Ironforge. Ach, these letters from me mum warm my heart. Here, not fair you don't get some readin', too. Take one of these manuals we have lyin' around.
234-complete.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-progress.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-progress.text: Is there something I can help you with?
234-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

282-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
282-accept.text:
I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... reliable hands. That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?

Hmm... you'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.

Speak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. It's completely infested with troggs now.

Follow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.
282-accept.title: Senir's Observations

3095-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
3095-accept.text: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the $c trainer Dannal. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
3095-accept.title: Simple Scroll

3095-complete.name: Dannal Stern
3095-complete.text:
I will be here to train you as you grow in experience... find me as often as you like. I charge a minimal fee, but you'll find everything I can teach you to be worthwhile.

Go now and test your skill. Many more things will become known to you as you gain experience, some of which I am unable to discuss with you here. Just know that Sylvanas will need warriors with your type of strength in the future. You will be the backbone of our salvation. Do not forget it.
3095-complete.title: Simple Scroll

3095-progress.name: Dannal Stern
3095-progress.text:
Ah, so you've arrived. Good. I overheard that a few others were able to escape "death" and were heading into town. Perhaps that resilience will pay off in the future also.

You may thank Sylvanas for your freedom... freedom of mind and body. Though you still remain tortured by the plague and its effects, you are now free to come and go as you see fit.
3095-progress.title: Simple Scroll

3112-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
3112-accept.text: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the $c trainer Thran. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
3112-accept.title: Simple Memorandum

3112-complete.name: Thran Khorman
3112-complete.text:
Well, seein' how this is your prime directive, or whatever yer callin' it these days, I gave my word I'd do whatever I can to make sure you and yours were ready to take back your home... and that's just what I'm gonna do.

Any time you feel yer ready, come back to good ol' Thran and I'll be happy to share my knowledge wit ya. There's some cost to me trainin' ya, but it won't be too expensive. Good luck.
3112-complete.title: Simple Memorandum

3112-progress.name: Thran Khorman
3112-progress.text:
Ah, well, another memorandum from a $r on a mission... isn't this quaint.

No, no, I ain't teasin' ya, little one. Gotta respect your tenacity, that much is fer sure. I'd be just as peeved if Ironforge was taken by Dark Iron dwarves, so don't be thinkin' I don't feel for your plight...
3112-progress.title: Simple Memorandum

3361-accept.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-accept.text:
We drove the troggs out of Gnomeregan, but then it all went so horribly wrong!  Now our home is completely irradiated, and we gnomes have been scattered all over Dun Morogh.

In my haste to get away from the radiation, I lost all my personal belongings and tools.  It was the trolls that got them.  They stole my chest, my box, and my bucket of bolts!  They took them back to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.

I'm no adventurer - could you find my things and bring them here to me, please?
3361-accept.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3361-complete.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-complete.text: Huzzah, you've found them!  You're an absolute savior, my friend.  Here, it's not much, but it's something for the trouble I've put you through!  Thank you!
3361-complete.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3361-progress.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-progress.text:
Oh goodness $N, this town is not well suited for the likes of me.  There are as many nasty creatures here as there were in Gnomeregan before the accident!

Do you have my belongings?  If you don't, then who knows what the trolls have done with them now...
3361-progress.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3364-accept.name: Nori Pridedrift
3364-accept.text:
Gah!  I was supposed to get this delicious scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar a while ago now, but I had to deliver one to Grelin here first.  I'll never make it to Anvilmar before the brew runs cold!

You look fast.  Maybe you can make it.  This cup will only stay hot for five more minutes, and Durnan didn't order "chilly" mornbrew, so get going.  Anvilmar is to the northeast, a settlement dug into the mountain.

Thanks, $N, and don't forget to bring me back my mug!
3364-accept.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3364-complete.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-complete.text: Ah good, now this will hit the spot.  Allow me to take a small break while I enjoy this scalding mornbrew!
3364-complete.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3364-progress.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-progress.text: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter.  You have something for me?
3364-progress.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3365-accept.name: Durnan Furcutter
3365-accept.text:
Now that hit the spot!  Nothing like a piping hot - nay, SCALDING mornbrew on a cold winter's day to warm your cackles of yer soul.

Here ya go $N - be a pal and take this empty mug back to Nori for me, would ya now.
3365-accept.title: Bring Back the Mug

363-accept.name: Undertaker Mordo
363-accept.text:
About time you woke up. We were ready to toss you into the fire with the others, but it looks like you made it.

I am Mordo, the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell. And you are the Lich King's slave no more.

Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel at the base of the hill, he will tell you more of what you must know.
363-accept.title: Rude Awakening

363-complete.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
363-complete.text:
Another of the walking dead, hm? Must have been quite a shock, waking up in the crypt with only the cold and Mordo to greet you...

I see the confusion on your face. Let me try to explain our... situation... to you.

We have been freed from the control of the Lich King by our new leader, Lady Sylvanas. The Dark Lady guides us in our war against the hated Scourge and the holdouts of humanity who dog our every step.
363-complete.title: Rude Awakening

364-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
364-accept.text:
We Forsaken are at war with the Lich King's army of the Scourge: necromantically raised armies of the $r, foul beasts of the north, and tormented spectres.

The northern part of the village has become overrun with the Mindless Ones, and they must be destroyed. Destroy them, show them no mercy, our former brothers and sisters as they might be. The Fallen are nothing but The Lich King's slaves.
364-accept.title: The Mindless Ones

364-complete.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
364-complete.text:
It is unfortunate that the Scourge cannot be brought into the fold, their large numbers would be useful in the battles ahead.

But they will not join us, so we have no choice but to destroy them.
364-complete.title: The Mindless Ones

376-accept.name: Novice Elreth
376-accept.text:
My duties include tending to our wounded warriors, tailoring armor and clothes, and assisting Shadow Priest Sarvis with whatever else he might need.

From the look of it, you'll be enlisted in his service also... hunting the Mindless Ones, if I know his mind. Well, if you'd like to stay in one piece--and I've no doubt you do--perhaps I can help. I'm running out of paws and wings, and if you bring me some, I'll find some armor for you. You'll find a good number of wolves and bats to the south.
376-accept.title: The Damned

3901-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
3901-accept.text:
You've shown your potential to the Forsaken under normal circumstances $N - now let's see you under pressure.

The Rattlecage skeletons, more mindless minions of the Lich King, are a tougher foe than the zombies you have faced thus far.  Again, thin their numbers and prove yourself to the Forsaken.  Do not tarry - when you are done, speak to me again.
3901-accept.title: Rattling the Rattlecages

94373-accept.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-accept.text:
Aye, the time's come, young $c. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the $c's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373-accept.title: Call of Earth

97277-accept.name: Grund Drokda
97277-accept.text:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.

Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.

Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
97277-accept.title: Grund and Gozwin

98581-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
98581-accept.text: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the $c trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98581-accept.title: Archaic Rune

98581-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
98581-complete.text: The shamanic arts have been kept by the Wildhammer clan for years, an' now those arts have passed into the care of the Bronzebeard dwarves as well. I'm here ta help spread these teachings an' offer guidance for new shamans learning the ways of the elements. Come ta me if ya need more trainin' in the spells of earth, air, fire, an' water.
98581-complete.title: Archaic Rune

98581-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
98581-progress.text: Ah, you were able to read the rune? It is imbued with the power of elements from some of our oldest script. That shows that you have the makings of a $c.
98581-progress.title: Archaic Rune
